study_question: Does abstaining when HAR→logistic max predicted probability is below a train-fold-chosen threshold improve selective MCC (on traded rows) and beat always-predict / always-abstain baselines under a minimum coverage floor?

model.abstain_rule: predict only if max(predicted_proba) >= tau; tau chosen on train fold to maximize MCC among taus in {0.40,0.45,0.50,0.55,0.60} with coverage>=0.20 on train

primary_metric.name: selective_MCC_on_traded_rows
primary_metric.screen: same advancement screen applied to traded-row preds vs truths; FAIL if coverage < 0.10 on OOS or under-sampled
